command:
set -euo pipefail; LEADER=$(machinectl show entityos -p Leader --value); PID=$(sudo -n nsenter --target "$LEADER" --mount --pid --uts --ipc --net -- systemctl show frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service -p MainPID --value); test "$(sudo -n nsenter --target "$LEADER" --mount --pid --uts --ipc --net -- systemctl is-active frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service)" = active; if pstree -ap "$PID" 2>/dev/null | grep -Eiq 'chrome|chromium|brave|playwright'; then echo CLIENT_BROWSER_DESCENDANTS=BAD; exit 31; fi; test ! -f /home/andreas/.gstack/browse.json; python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3,json
p='/var/lib/entityos/data/unified.db'; epoch='3707680c104d456f95c6d12c67036acb'; c=sqlite3.connect(p)
epoch_n=c.execute('select count(*) from f2_runtime_epoch where runtime_epoch_id=?',(epoch,)).fetchone()[0]
frame_n=c.execute('select count(*) from f2_grid10_frame where runtime_epoch_id=?',(epoch,)).fetchone()[0]
ptr=c.execute('select count(*) from f2_grid10_turn_pointer where runtime_epoch_id=?',(epoch,)).fetchone()[0]
print(json.dumps({'runtime_epoch_present':epoch_n,'grid_frames':frame_n,'turn_pointers':ptr},sort_keys=True))
assert epoch_n>=1 and frame_n>=1 and ptr>=1
PY
echo SERVICE=active; echo CLIENT_BROWSER_DESCENDANTS=0; echo OLD_GSTACK_STATE_EXISTS=no; echo CANONICAL_REENTRY=PASS; echo FINAL_BROWSERLESS_PARITY=PASS
